order_note: Predecessor and supersedes SQL 109 (owner 2026-11-13: "Build the transfer to bank"; design docs/WALLET_TO_BANK_TRANSFER_DESIGN.md, #1849). SQL 164 replaces SQL 109's public.aws_moov_webhook_apply_transfer_status in place with one change: wallet_withdrawal joins wallet_funding, send_wallet and send_bank as the legs the webhook writer owns, so a transfer to bank's Moov status, ACH return and NOC reach ChecksOps (the status catch-up job routes the same legs to the same writer). Everything else is SQL 109's; EXECUTE checksops and the owner only. It also adds two nullable bigint columns to public.tenant_wallet_funding_settings, wallet_withdraw_max_per_transfer_cents and wallet_withdraw_max_per_day_cents (the tenant's own limits; NULL = no limit), each with a NULL-or-positive CHECK, and column INSERT and UPDATE on them for checksops. SQL 146 is unchanged: its collection writer already answers not_owned for this leg. The engine refuses SQL 164 (predecessors_applied) unless SQL 109 reads applied; after SQL 164, SQL 109 counts as applied while SQL 164 is (supersedes; SQL 109's only object is the replaced function, so no superseded_intended_sha256 is pinned). The spec prerequisites are the file's own (55000 sql164_prerequisite_missing); the applying login must own payment_transfers, payment_event_log and tenant_wallet_funding_settings without FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY (sql164_definer_cannot_write). Expected pre-state in both environments: the function as SQL 109 left it and the two columns and checks absent (release sql164 v1: 51e721c14833afe91c1236bd618735b2adb75e7acc2f01b03c109c98ab9c19d7). The API (providers/production/moov-wallet-withdraw.mjs) and the Wallet & Treasury button ship after this through their own guarded paths; no API, Lambda or SPA change is part of this pin.
